services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services in Blackpool
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle all your plumbing and heating needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most jobs the same day.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual gas boiler servicing keeps your heating safe and efficient. We diagnose faults quickly and repair on site whenever possible.

services.title: Boiler Installations
services.desc: New gas or hybrid boiler fitted with full certification. We advise on the right size and efficiency rating to cut your heating bills.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete heating system design and installation for new builds or full replacements. Guaranteed work and 5-year parts warranty.

services.title: Radiator Replacement & Balancing
services.desc: Cold radiators made hot again. We replace damaged rads, bleed air, and balance your system for even warmth throughout.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap and cistern repairs, new sink installations, and bathroom pipework. We work with your builder or independently.

about_pullquote: I started this because I was tired of seeing locals ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: AH Heating & Plumbing has served Blackpool homes and businesses for over 15 years. We began as a one-man operation and have built our reputation on honest pricing, quick turnarounds, and work that lasts. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and fully qualified in plumbing and heating installation.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we answer the phone, we turn up on time, and we explain what's wrong before we start work. No hidden charges, no pressure to replace parts that don't need replacing. We're local, we care about the area, and we back everything we do with a warranty.
reviews_heading: What Blackpool Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator the night before Christmas. Rang AH and they came out within 45 minutes. Brilliant service, fair price, and the job's held up perfectly. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted by these lads last winter. They explained everything clearly, tidy workers, and the heating runs like a dream now. Much warmer and cheaper bills. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Linda K.

reviews.text: Burst pipe in the kitchen while we were away. Called AH on the emergency line and they unblocked and patched it same day. No fuss, no drama, sorted it properly. Best £200 I've spent.
reviews.author: James P.
